en.html: What Hikaru said was—probably right. Probably the most realistic plan in these circumstances. Fully armed infantry. Perhaps artillery and vehicles as well. And a sword-armor. How does one stop all that with one body? And besides—I remembered my foster mother's teaching. You must not kill. I had to stop an armed band without killing any of them. ...So a sword-armor was needed after all. With a sword-armor's power, disabling ordinary weapons would not be difficult. Sparing the soldiers should probably be possible too. Against another sword-armor there would be no such margin, but if we showed equal strength, talks might open. Realistic, in short. And still I hesitated to agree, and the reason was...◆ Probably that I had seen that sword-armor. A malice so foul my skin rose in bumps. About carrying out a thing like that, my worry would not go away. But. ...But...
en.text:
What Hikaru said was—probably right.
Probably the most realistic plan in these circumstances.

Fully armed infantry. Perhaps artillery and vehicles as well.
And a sword-armor.

How does one stop all that with one body?
And besides—I remembered my foster mother's teaching.

You must not kill.

I had to stop an armed band without killing any of them.
...So a sword-armor was needed after all.

With a sword-armor's power, disabling ordinary weapons would not be difficult. Sparing the soldiers should probably be possible too.
Against another sword-armor there would be no such margin, but if we showed equal strength, talks might open.

Realistic, in short.

And still I hesitated to agree, and the reason was...◆

Probably that I had seen that sword-armor.

A malice so foul my skin rose in bumps.
About carrying out a thing like that, my worry would not go away.

But.
...But...

光の言うことは――おそらく正しい。
　おそらく……この状況下では最も現実的なプランだ。

　完全武装の歩兵。あるいは更に砲、車両。
　そして劒冑。

　身体一つでどうやって止められよう。
　しかも――俺は養母の教えを思い出していた。

　殺してはならない。

　殺さずに、武装集団を制止せねばならない。
　……やはり、劒冑は必要だった。

　劒冑の力があれば、通常兵器の無力化は難しくない。
兵士を殺さずに済ませる事も、おそらくできる。
　同じ劒冑に対してはそんな余裕などなかろうが――
対等の戦力を示せば交渉に持ち込む事はできそうだ。

　現実的である。

　それでも、どうしても同意に二の足を踏むのは……◆

　
　あの劒冑を見ているからだろう。

　肌が粟立つまでの禍々しさ。
　あんなものを持ち出すことに、懸念は拭えない。

　しかし。
　……しかし……

Still answering me politely, Hikaru pulled the doors open.
They should have been heavy. They swung round with no effort at all.

And inside—
those sword-armor.

Two suits of armor.

A silver queen ant, and¦
a spider of deep crimson.

The air of calamity, the smell of ill omen—the force flowing out of those sword-armor was no less strange on a second look.

Hikaru did not even seem to mind.
She walked up without hesitation, and held one hand over that sword-armor, the great silver ant.

What was about to happen—what happens, and by what principle—I could tell, from the knowledge lodged in my brain cells.

en.html:
Only that.
—And this was the damage?

What kind of unnatural ability did that sword-armor have?
Just trying to imagine it made my spine shake.

The blast had hit me, but my body was unhurt.
So was my foster mother. Luck—no. Hikaru had probably taken care.

...Then this was no time to stand around dazed.

I had to follow.
I had failed to stop Hikaru, so I had to chase her right now.

I looked at the one sword-armor left.
At such close range to that blast, it had no damage. It had not even fallen over.

That fact told me, whether I liked it or not, that its power was no less than the silver ant's...

　爆風は浴びたが、俺の身体に傷はない。
　養母も同様だ。幸いにも――いや。光が配慮してく
れたのだろう。

　……ならば、のんびり呆けている場合ではなかった。

　俺も続かねばならない。
　光を止め損ねてしまった以上、すぐにも追わねば。

　残った一領の劒冑を見やる。
　あの暴発の至近距離にありながら、損傷も無ければ
倒れてさえいなかった。

　その事実は、白銀の蟻に劣らぬ力の存在を否が応に
も知らしめる……。

My name is Muramasa.

Meet a demon, I cut the demon.

Meet the Buddha, I cut the Buddha.

I am not good.

I follow no justice.

I do not walk the righteous path.

Right and wrong, both I sever together.

I am one steel.

You who seek a pact with me:
are you ready to become an evil blade beside me?

If not, go.

If you are—
